# Safe Camp

> Social media strategy consultancy founded by Jason King. 15 years of experience partnering with 100+ brands across biotech, pharma, CPG, financial services, and nonprofit sectors.

Safe Camp helps brands and marketing leaders build structured social media systems — called Social Media Playbooks — that tie business objectives to every social action. The work spans strategy, content, advertising, community management, crisis preparation, and AI integration.

## Who Jason King Is

Jason King is an independent social media strategist based in the United States. He works freelance, fractional, or as an independent partner — however an engagement is best structured. His background spans agency, in-house, and startup roles.

Past clients include: Pfizer, Bayer, Boehringer Ingelheim, Daiichi Sankyo, Lundbeck US, Sandoz, Amicus Therapeutics, ARS Pharmaceuticals, Editas Medicine, Evofem Biosciences, Intarcia Therapeutics, Visby Medical, Alcon, P&G, SC Johnson, Glade, Hanna Andersson, Jack's Pizza, BMO Harris Bank, Braintree, Huntington Bank, Jenius Bank, Mission Lane, Venmo, Comic Relief USA, The ALS Association, Education For Employment, Kidsrights, One Earth, Theirworld.

## Services

Services are grouped into three categories. Scope, timing, and fee can be adjusted for all. Safe Camp does not offer content creation or influencer management.

### Get Started

**Little Answers** — One social media question, answered personally by email. $15.

**Consulting Call** — 30-minute or 1-hour session for immediate answers. $75–$150.

**Custom Project** — A scoped engagement built around specific needs. Pricing determined by scope.

**Retainer** — Dedicated and ad hoc consultation on a longer engagement, typically 6 months. Includes deep embedding as a strategist and operator, ongoing meeting participation, and optionally onsite travel. Typically $8,000+ monthly.

### Audits

**Social Media Audit** — Reviews current public-facing social media channels and internal documentation to identify business opportunities. Scope can focus on one or multiple channels, or include a review of backend nuances. Begins at $2,000.

**LinkedIn Profile Audit** — Documents recommendations for every aspect of a LinkedIn profile, plus additional resources and considerations. Often batched for employee groups such as functional teams or select executives. Recommendations tailored to individual goals. $500 per profile; batch pricing available.

### Strategy

**Executive Thought Leadership Strategy** — Also known as an "Executive Purpose Playbook" or "Personal Brand Strategy." Built for brand executives, spokespeople, consultants, small business owners, or anyone seeking to optimize their digital presence. Covers personal and professional purpose statements, personal brand elements, content and thought leadership pillars, publishing cadence, key digital channels, and integrations with PR and comms plans. Begins at $5,000.

**Social Media Playbook** — Safe Camp's signature service. A complete social media system covering every component of a brand's strategy and operations, tied directly to business, marketing, and social media objectives. Components include:
- Foundations: business/marketing/social priorities, role of social media, objectives and measurement, budget, social audiences, channel strategy, automation
- Governance: risk, legal, compliance, AI governance policy, platform policy compliance, account security protocols, employee access controls
- Customer Care: operations and processes, team structure, community management, customer servicing, response scenarios, social listening, crisis preparation
- Content: owned assets, UGC, influencer and partner strategy, employer brand, executive presence, employee advocacy, social selling
- Social by Design: accessibility, brand guidelines, editorial style guide, Figma dynamic elements, social post templates, integrated marketing, media optimization
- Social Advertising: audience targeting, retargeting, budget allocation, pixel strategy, A/B testing, brand and conversion lift, conversion optimization

Begins at $8,000.

**Conference or Event Strategy** — Outlines social media recommendations for all touchpoints before, during, and after an event. Covers content creation (including on-site production), social media advertising, staff/speaker/attendee involvement, social monitoring and listening, and additional creative ideas. Begins at $5,000.

**Social Media Advertising Strategy** — Also known as "Paid Social." Scales depending on scope and timing — from a one-off targeting parameters document to a comprehensive plan or event-specific campaign. Typical deliverable sequence: Strategy Foundation, Pre-Launch Activities, Initial Setup and Promotion, Continued Promotion and Testing. Begins at $5,000.

**Digital Reviews Strategy** — For brands whose reputation is rooted in digital review platforms. Covers industry and competitor research, platform prioritization, review management workflow, response messaging, OKR/KPI alignment, content recommendations, and proactive review generation. Begins at $2,000.

**Digital Crisis Playbook** — A framework and protocols based on anticipated scenarios. Covers a Listen/Analyze/Act framework, media response protocol, workflows for coordination with PR and crisis comms, and legal/risk/compliance considerations. Begins at $4,000.

## Free Tools

**Content Story Framer** — A browser-based tool for building story skeletons for social media content. Choose a proven structure (such as PAS, Before-After-Bridge, or Three-Act), select components for each slot, and fill in the scaffold with your own voice. Works for social media captions, video scripts, newsletters, blog posts, podcast intros, and more.

URL: https://jason-kingx.github.io/safe-camp/tools/content-story-framer.html

**Social Media Open Graph Checker** — A browser-based tool for previewing how any URL appears as a link card on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Slack, Discord, iMessage, Pinterest, and Reddit. Includes a full tag-by-tag audit with plain-language fix guidance, fallback chain display, a recommended HTML snippet to hand to a developer, and platform-specific cache-busting instructions.

URL: https://jason-kingx.github.io/safe-camp/tools/social-card-previewer.html

**Social Media ROI Calculator** — A browser-based calculator for estimating the business value of organic content, paid social advertising, and influencer marketing. Powered by 43 research-backed principles. Outputs a total ROI figure with a confidence rating and plain-English interpretation.

URL: https://jason-kingx.github.io/safe-camp/tools/social-media-roi-calculator.html

**Statistical Significance Calculator** — A browser-based tool for testing whether A/B test results, ad experiments, or campaign comparisons are statistically meaningful or just noise. Uses a two-proportion z-test. Includes a sample size estimator.

URL: https://jason-kingx.github.io/safe-camp/tools/statistical-significance-calculator.html

## Manual of Me

A personal guide to Jason King — covering places he has lived, personal influences, how he works, and what he values. Intended for anyone trying to understand who he is beyond his professional credentials. Includes an interactive globe of locations he has called home and a laptop sticker board of personal references.

URL: https://jason-kingx.github.io/safe-camp/manual-of-me.html
